facts.fact: The Minister's 2026/27 budget speech, as reported, says NICTBB connects 122 of 139 districts (87.8%) after 13 districts were added in 2025/26, total network 15,167 km; as_of is the article date.
The ministry reports 801 km of new NICTBB fibre built in fiscal 2025/26 and plans 10 more districts in 2026/27; as_of is 2025/26 fiscal year works, dated by article.
